changes.comment: New `ohhi` command line for your vault: search it, read a note or one section of it, follow wikilinks and backlinks, list tags, and patch, append, move, trash or restore a note — with the app open or closed.
Point it at a vault three ways — `--vault`, the `OHHI_VAULT` environment variable, or just being inside one. Two possible vaults are named and refused rather than guessed between.
`--json` on any command prints one versioned document, so scripts and agents can read the output; the plain form stays readable for people, and warnings never contaminate the pipe.
Connect any MCP-capable tool to a vault with `claude mcp add ohhi -- ohhi mcp --vault <path>`, which offers the same commands as tools.
Starts fast enough to use in a loop — a cold run over a thousand-note vault answers in well under half a second.
